claim: The Council has 13 members elected on a partisan basis: a chair and 4 at large, and one from each of 8 wards
quote: shall consist of 13 members elected on a partisan basis. The Chairman and 4 members shall be elected at large in the District, and 8 members shall be elected 1 each from the 8 election wards

claim: Council terms are four years, starting January 2 after the election
quote: The term of office of the members of the Council shall be 4 years

claim: A party may nominate one fewer at-large candidate than the number of at-large seats up
quote: a political party may nominate a number of candidates for the office of at-large member of the Council equal to 1 less than the total number of at-large members

claim: The Mayor is elected on a partisan basis for four years
quote: shall be elected, on a partisan basis, for a term of 4 years

claim: The Attorney General is elected on a partisan basis
quote: shall be elected on a partisan basis by the registered qualified electors of the District

claim: The Council holds the District’s legislative power, subject to the Home Rule Act limits
quote: the legislative power granted to the District by this chapter is vested in and shall be exercised by the Council

claim: Each act is read twice, at least 13 days apart
quote: Each proposed act shall be read twice in substantially the same form, with at least 13 days intervening between each reading

claim: Emergency acts take effect at once and last up to 90 days
quote: such act shall be effective for a period of not to exceed 90 days

claim: The Mayor has 10 working days to approve or veto an act
quote: within 10 calendar days (excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and holidays) after the act is presented to him, either approve or disapprove such act

claim: An act the Mayor does not return in time is deemed approved
quote: the Mayor shall be deemed to have approved it

claim: Each act is sent to Congress and takes effect after a 30-day review period (counting only days Congress is in session)
quote: such act shall take effect upon the expiration of the 30-calendar-day period

claim: Acts in the criminal code titles get a 60-day review
quote: such act shall take effect at the end of the 60-day period beginning on the day such act is transmitted

claim: Congress can disapprove an act by joint resolution during review
quote: unless, during such 60-day period, there has been enacted into law a joint resolution disapproving such act

claim: Congress keeps the power to legislate for the District on any subject at any time
quote: the Congress of the United States reserves the right, at any time, to exercise its constitutional authority as legislature for the District

claim: Primaries for local offices are on the third Tuesday in June of non-presidential even years
quote: 3rd Tuesday in June of each even-numbered non-presidential election year

claim: Primaries are the first Tuesday in June in presidential years and the third Tuesday in June in other even years
quote: shall be held on the 1st Tuesday in June in a presidential election year and on the 3rd Tuesday in June

claim: General elections for local offices are in November of even-numbered years
quote: general elections for such office shall be held on the Tuesday next after the 1st Monday in November of each even-numbered year

claim: Ranked-choice voting applies from the June 2026 primary to contests with three or more candidates for Mayor, Council, AG, State Board, ANC and others
quote: beginning with the June 2026 primary election and for all subsequent elections thereafter, ranked choice voting as provided for by this section shall be used for each primary, special, and general election involving 3 or more qualified candidates

claim: RCV covers ANC and State Board races
quote: members of the State Board of Education, United States Senator, United States Representative, Advisory Neighborhood Commissioner

claim: Voters may rank up to five candidates
quote: Each ballot shall allow a voter to rank up to 5 candidates

claim: A party-registered voter cannot be nominated directly (by petition) for Council, Mayor or AG; only those not registered with a primary-holding party can
quote: No person shall be nominated directly as a candidate in any general election for the office of Delegate, Chairman of the Council, member of the Council, Mayor, Attorney General

claim: Direct nomination bar applies to voters registered with a party that holds a primary
quote: who is registered to vote as affiliated with a party qualified to conduct a primary election

claim: State Board of Education elections are nonpartisan
quote: The election of the members of the State Board of Education shall be conducted on a nonpartisan basis

claim: State Board candidates are nominated by petition
quote: shall be nominated for such office by a nominating petition

claim: The State Board of Education has 9 elected members: one per ward and one at large
quote: the Board shall consist of 9 elected members. One member shall be elected from each of the 8 school election wards created pursuant to

claim: State Board members serve four-year terms
quote: the term of office of a member of the Board, including the at-large member, shall be 4 years

claim: State Board elections are nonpartisan (education title)
quote: The election of the members of the Board shall be conducted on a nonpartisan basis

claim: ANC elections are in November of even-numbered years
quote: general elections of members of Advisory Neighborhood Commissions shall take place on the 1st Tuesday after the 1st Monday in November of each even-numbered calendar year

claim: ANC commissioners serve two-year terms
quote: Each member of an Advisory Neighborhood Commission shall serve for a term of 2 years

claim: ANC candidates are nominated by petition of voters in their single-member district
quote: Candidates for member of an Advisory Neighborhood Commission shall be nominated by a petition

claim: An ANC commissioner must live in the single-member district and hold no other elected office
quote: Is a registered qualified elector actually residing in the single-member district from which the person was elected

claim: ANC commissioners hold no other elected office
quote: Holds no other elected public office

claim: Each single-member district has about 2,000 people
quote: Each single-member district shall have a population of approximately 2,000 people
